symptom: A message definition collection created with MDL does not appear in documents(), so a lint rule on its name (a required MD_ prefix) can never fire.
cause: documents() reads the catalog objects view, and the catalog had no table for MessageDefinitions$MessageDefinitionCollection or its 11.15 replacement MessageDefinitions$MessageDefinition2, so neither was ever unioned into objects.
insight: A document type missing from documents() is a missing catalog table, not a linter bug: buildSimpleNamedDocs plus a view, an objects UNION arm, a Tables() entry and a schema bump is the whole recipe, and TestTables_CoversAllViews / TestDescribeAutoCoversCatalogObjectTypes name every other place that has to agree. Cover both storage shapes of a type Mendix replaced in place. For the control, pick a kind built the same way (raw units): JSON structures go through ListJsonStructures, so a raw-unit mock leaves them out and the control fails for the wrong reason.
